title: Square (Block) - POS and payments platform for small and micro businesses
clean_text: Square (renamed Block Inc. in 2021) is a San Francisco-based commerce platform offering point-of-sale, payment processing, business banking, e-commerce, inventory management, CRM, and invoicing tools, originally built for restaurants and small businesses. It has over four million users worldwide, with roughly 70% of gross payment volume coming from small-to-medium-sized business customers, and quick-service restaurants as a particularly strong segment. In 2025, Square's revenue reached about $24.5 billion (up 22% year-over-year) on roughly $210 billion in gross payment volume.

meta.target: small and micro businesses, particularly quick-service restaurants and retail
meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription plus usage-based transaction fees
